channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Conselho de Ética analisa pareceres sobre processos por quebra de decoro e ouve testumunhas
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies' Ethics Council meets on Tuesday (30) to review preliminary opinions on misconduct complaints against deputies Paulo Bilynskyj (PL-SP), Rogério Correia (PT-MG) and Erika Hilton (Psol-SP), and to hear witnesses in the case against André Janones (Avante-MG), accused of demanding refunds from staff salaries to benefit his campaign.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula vai a lançamento de fragata em Itajaí (SC)
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva attends the launching and christening ceremony of the frigate Cunha Moreira (F202) in Itajaí (SC) on Friday, June 26, 2026. The vessel, the third of the Tamandaré-class, is fully built in Brazil and part of the National Defense Industrial Base strengthening program, emphasizing national labor, technology transfer, and protection of the Blue Amazon.

item.title: Lula discutirá ampliação do fundo do Mercosul no Paraguai
item.description: President Lula will announce in Asunción, Paraguay, on June 30, an increase in Brazil’s investment in the Focem, the Mercosul Structural Convergence Fund, currently financed at 70% by Brazil (US$70 million). The summit will also formalize the launch of negotiations for a trade agreement with Japan, although no Japanese officials will attend in person. The meeting will include the presidents of Argentina, Paraguay, Uruguay, Bolivia, Chile, and Ecuador, along with representatives from associate countries and regional organizations.

item.title: Devagar, Durigan, que esse negócio com a China não é negócio da China
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan is accused of using the issuance of panda bonds in yuan as a smokescreen to hide rising public spending and inflation, while promoting an anti-American foreign policy under the guise of cooperation with China. The article criticizes the Lula government for maintaining high protectionist tariffs and non-tariff barriers despite claiming to seek increased trade with the U.S., and argues that issuing debt in yuan is more a partisan act than a sound economic strategy.

item.title: ‘Muito sério’: Valdemar antecipa volta ao Brasil após crise entre Michelle e Flávio
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto, president of the PL, announced an early return from abroad to mediate a crisis between Michelle Bolsonaro and Flávio Bolsonaro after she claimed he humiliated her in a video. The party seeks to contain internal damage stemming from Michelle’s opposition to the alliance with Ciro Gomes, which is backed by Jair Bolsonaro’s sons, aiming to prevent electoral setbacks in 2026.

item.title: Michelle usa versículo sobre 'falsa testemunha'; esposa de Flávio rebate
item.description: Former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro cited a biblical verse about 'false witness', likely in response to criticism against her family. Hours later, Fernanda Bolsonaro, wife of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, rebutted with another biblical passage about a 'lying tongue', signaling a religiously framed exchange of accusations.

item.title: Rubio responde a carta de Flávio Bolsonaro e reforça defesa de tarifas contra o Brasil
item.description: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio replied to a letter from Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, reaffirming the U.S. intention to impose new tariffs on Brazil due to trade practices deemed harmful by Washington and supporting the designation of Brazilian criminal factions PCC and CV as global terrorists. He thanked Bolsonaro for his support of the anti-terrorism measure and emphasized the importance of a U.S.-Brazil partnership rooted in shared values, despite ongoing trade disputes.

item.title: Caso do filme 'Dark Horse' pode levar PF a abrir até 3 inquéritos nos próximos dias
item.description: The Federal Police is expected to open up to three investigations in the coming days regarding the funding of the film 'Dark Horse', examining R$ 61 million in transfers from Daniel Vorcaro at the request of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, potential use of those funds to support Eduardo Bolsonaro in the U.S., and the direction of parliamentary amendments to entities linked to the film’s producer. The STF has assigned Justice André Mendonça as the rapporteur for the main inquiry, rejecting a request for Justice Alexandre de Moraes to lead it due to his prior role in Eduardo Bolsonaro’s coercion case. Documents suggest links between the film’s producer, the PCC, and the fraud network tied to the former Banco Master.

item.title: Caso Eletrozema explica resistência de Zema a divulgar isenções fiscais em MG
item.description: Romeu Zema defended the secrecy of fiscal exemptions in Minas Gerais, claiming that disclosing the beneficiary companies would be harmful. The revelation that Eletrozema avoided paying R$ 2.2 million in taxes suggests the real motive behind the secrecy may be tied to specific interests, not the state's welfare.

item.title: Direita zoa Casimiro por apoiar Lula e “virar alvo” do governo
item.description: Right-wing politicians criticize Casimiro Miguel for supporting Lula in 2022 and now being targeted by a Ministry of Justice investigation into CazéTV over alleged irregular gambling advertisements during Copa 2026 broadcasts. CazéTV announced it will adopt a more conservative standard for gambling brand activations to preserve spontaneity and ensure responsibility and transparency.

item.title: ‘Ex-bolsonarista’ escapa de processo por difamação após se retratar com Moraes
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Nunes Marques extinguished the criminal liability of federal deputy Otoni de Paula for defamation against Minister Alexandre de Moraes following two public retractions made in 2020 and 2025. However, Otoni remains charged with insult and obstruction of justice, which are not nullified by retractions. The former Bolsonaro ally, now critical of the ex-president, publicly apologized for calling Moraes 'trash', 'scoundrel', and other slurs during live streams.

item.title: Investigação sobre financiamento de Dark Horse fica nas mãos de Mendonça
item.description: Minister André Mendonça will serve as rapporteur for the investigation into the alleged R$134 million financing by former banker Daniel Vorcaro to Senator Flávio Bolsonaro for the film Dark Horse, a decision made by STF President Edson Fachin. The rapporteurship was assigned by prevention, as the facts are more closely tied to the Banco Master fraud investigation—already under Mendonça’s responsibility—than to Alexandre de Moraes’ coup-related inquiry. Both Flávio Bolsonaro’s defense and the PGR endorsed Mendonça’s appointment.

item.title: Marco Rubio envia carta a Flávio Bolsonaro para reafirmar tarifas dos EUA contra o Brasil
item.description: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio sent a letter to Senator Flávio Bolsonaro reaffirming the possibility of new U.S. tariffs against Brazil, citing Brazilian policies on digital commerce, Pix, ethanol, and deforestation as harmful to the American economy. Rubio also thanked Bolsonaro for supporting the U.S. designation of PCC and CV as terrorist groups, a move criticized by the Lula government as a potential pretext for U.S. military intervention.

item.title: O plano da campanha de Flávio para reconciliação com Michelle inclui encontro dos dois em evento
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign is pursuing a cautious, incremental approach to reconciliation with Michelle Bolsonaro, avoiding direct confrontation and focusing on slowly rebuilding their narrative, according to sources within the campaign's leadership. The strategy is described as 'homeopathic doses,' implying no dramatic or immediate actions are planned. An upcoming joint event is part of this quiet reconciliation effort.

item.title: Jaques Wagner admite relação com ex-sócio do Master e diz que reclamou a Lula de 'patacoada' da PF
item.description: Former Bahia governor Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) said he complained to President Lula about the Federal Police's conduct in the operation he was targeted in, especially the release of a photo showing foreign currency seized from his Brasília apartment, calling it a 'botched job'. He stepped down as government leader in the Senate a day before the interview.

item.title: Meio-Dia em Brasília: Michelle toca fogo no parquinho do PL
item.description: The Meio-Dia em Brasília program discussed Valdemar Costa Neto's emergency return to Brazil to contain the PL party crisis after Michelle Bolsonaro posted a video publicly criticizing her stepson and presidential pre-candidate, Flávio Bolsonaro. The situation highlights internal party tensions ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: ‘Vá cozinhar’, é o que sugere vídeo de Michelle sobre telefonema de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: A video of Michelle Bolsonaro suggesting that Flávio Bolsonaro 'go cook' after a phone call was released, reigniting debates about family dynamics and politics within the bolsonarist movement. Michelle, now president of PL Mulher and a central figure in the right-wing articulations for 2026, has gained visibility as a potential political leader. The episode reflects internal tensions and the growing exposure of Bolsonaro family members in Brazil's electoral landscape.

item.title: Ciro Gomes se esquiva de briga entre Michelle e Flávio: ‘Não vi o vídeo e nem vou ver’
item.description: Ciro Gomes distanced himself from the conflict between Michelle Bolsonaro and Flávio Bolsonaro, stating he did not see and will not watch the video in which she accuses him of humiliating her. Despite avoiding the dispute, he remains a central figure, having been criticized by Michelle, who holds him responsible for Jair Bolsonaro's ineligibility and supports Eduardo Girão as an alternative candidate in Ceará.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro posta críticas a Michelle e elogios a Flávio após crise familiar
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro indirectly criticized Michelle Bolsonaro by sharing content questioning her motives and supporting his brother Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential pre-candidacy, following Michelle's videos accusing Flávio of humiliation. He reinforced the narrative that Michelle acts out of personal interest and emotional reaction, while allies and Flávio frame the family conflict as an impulsive decision driven by emotion.

item.title: Valdemar diz que desentendimento entre Michelle e Flávio Bolsonaro 'é muito sério' e antecipa volta ao Brasil
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto, national president of the PL, returned early from abroad to Brazil to mediate a growing rift between Michelle Bolsonaro and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, calling the dispute 'very serious'. He emphasized Michelle's importance to the party and warned that internal division harms electoral prospects, noting Flávio is nearly tied with Lula in polls. The conflict began when Michelle accused Flávio of mistreatment in a phone call, sparking public backlash and appeals for unity to defeat the Lula government.

item.title: Antes da treta, Michelle e Flávio eram unidos pelos cheques de Queiroz
item.description: Before their current public rifts, Michelle Bolsonaro and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro maintained a close financial relationship with Fabrício Queiroz, tied to check disbursements that became the subject of investigations by the Rio de Janeiro Public Ministry. Though rarely referenced in the family’s current public clashes, this connection reveals a prior financial interdependence that preceded later political and personal ruptures.

item.title: Ciro Gomes diz que não viu vídeo de Michelle sobre Flávio
item.description: Ciro Gomes (PSDB) said he did not watch and does not intend to watch the video in which Michelle Bolsonaro (PL) claims she was mistreated by Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ). He distanced himself from the internal PL dispute, stating it is a national matter to be resolved by the party itself, and emphasized that his national political role is in the past.

item.title: Por que o Brasil precisa de usinas de reserva para evitar o colapso elétrico?
item.description: Brazil faces growing risk of systemic blackouts due to insufficient power reserve capacity, despite advances in renewable energy. Between 6 PM and 9 PM, the disappearance of solar generation requires injecting 25–40 GW of firm power within 120 minutes, straining hydro and thermal plants. Recent events in 2023, late 2024–early 2025, and October 2025 exposed structural fragility, prompting preventive cuts and emergency activation of out-of-merit-order thermal plants.

item.title: Saiba quem são as vítimas estrangeiras dos terremotos na Venezuela
item.description: Two strong earthquakes of magnitudes 7.2 and 7.5 struck Venezuela, causing at least 235 deaths, including foreign nationals. Brazil, Portugal, Spain, Italy, and China confirmed casualties among their citizens, with many still missing. Multiple countries dispatched rescue teams and humanitarian aid, including Brazil sending a KC-390 aircraft and Swiss and Spanish search-and-rescue units.

item.title: JHC tem 52% das intenções de voto e Renan Filho, 37% em AL
item.description: João Henrique Caldas (PSDB), former mayor of Maceió, leads with 52% voting intentions for the governorship of Alagoas in a potential runoff, while Senator Renan Filho (MDB) has 37%, according to a TDL survey conducted from June 20 to 22, 2026. The poll, registered with the TSE under number AL-04608/2026, has a margin of error of 2.7 percentage points and a 95% confidence level.

item.title: Moraes deve definir prisão de Jair Bolsonaro apenas na semana que vem
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes is expected to decide next week whether to maintain or revoke the house arrest of former President Jair Bolsonaro. Bolsonaro's defense filed a request on Tuesday to extend the house arrest measure. STF sources indicate the decision will be postponed until next week.

item.title: O que ainda pode prejudicar Lula apesar de saída de Jaques da liderança do governo
item.description: Despite Jaques Wagner's resignation from the government leadership in the Senate, the six-day delay in his removal after being targeted by PF's Operation Compliance Zero may harm Lula, as allies acknowledge that the inertia exposes the government to adversarial attacks and could negatively affect his performance in upcoming polls.

item.title: Disputa entre Flávio e Michelle faz Valdemar antecipar retorno de Miami
item.description: PL national president Valdemar Costa Neto cut short his trip to Miami to return to Brazil and mediate an internal party dispute between Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, a pre-candidate for president, and former first lady Michelle Bolsonaro. The conflict threatens party unity ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Cleitinho sai em defesa de Michelle: "Atacada de forma covarde"
item.description: Senator Cleitinho Azevedo (Republicanos) defended former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro (PL), stating she has been unfairly and cowardly attacked by members of the right wing, and appealed for unity among Bolsonaro supporters ahead of the 2026 elections. He emphasized that Michelle is caring for Bolsonaro, whom he described as unjustly imprisoned, and criticized internal divisions weakening the right’s electoral prospects. The statement followed Michelle’s public disclosure of a tense phone call with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), who denied disrespecting her and apologized for the incident.

item.title: ‘Dark Horse’: Fachin decide Mendonça como relator de investigação sobre pedido de Flávio a Vorcaro
item.description: Supreme Court President Edson Fachin assigned Minister André Mendonça as rapporteur of the criminal complaint against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro concerning the 'Dark Horse' film financing by Banco Master and alleged transfers to Eduardo Bolsonaro in the U.S. The decision follows a PGR opinion stating the facts are more closely linked to an existing investigation led by Mendonça on banker Daniel Vorcaro. The case involves suspicions that film funds were used to support Eduardo Bolsonaro's actions against Brazilian authorities.

item.title: Direita, volver: a onda conservadora que varre a América do Sul com incentivo de Trump
item.description: Conservative right-wing forces are gaining ground in South America, with victories by Abelardo de la Espriella in Colombia and Keiko Fujimori in Peru, driven by promises to combat violence and narcotrafficking. These results expand Donald Trump’s influence in the region, which he views as the next political test for his conservative agenda. The shift marks the end of the progressive cycle that dominated the continent for three years, leaving only Brazil and Uruguay as exceptions.

item.title: Os bastidores da saída de Jaques Wagner da liderança do governo Lula no Senado
item.description: Jaques Wagner, leader of Lula's government in the Senate and a close ally of the president, was accused by the Federal Police of acting in favor of former banker Daniel Vorcaro in the Banco Master scheme, allegedly receiving bribes including a R$ 2.5 million apartment and Los Angeles concert box seats. The company of Wagner's stepchild's wife also allegedly received multi-million-dollar transfers. Wagner appealed to the STF, denying the accusations and claiming he acted against Banco Master's interests.

item.title: Racha familiar exposto por Michelle pode ameaçar candidatura de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro publicly exposed a family rift by revealing that Flávio Bolsonaro and his siblings attacked her on social media for opposing the PL’s alliance with Ciro Gomes in Ceará. She accused Ciro of calling Jair Bolsonaro a genocida and thief, and of insulting her family, making his support unacceptable. Pastor Silas Malafaia, a close ally, avoided direct comments but used biblical quotes to imply internal division within the Bolsonaro clan, which could harm Flávio’s 2026 Senate bid.

item.title: Proposta com apelo eleitoral pode virar nova dor de cabeça para Lula no Congresso
item.description: The Lula government faces congressional pushback over a proposal to raise the MEI annual revenue cap from R$81,000 to R$140,000 by 2028, with the Centrão bloc demanding inclusion of a Simples Nacional adjustment that could trigger R$50 billion in annual revenue loss. The initiative, originally slated for submission last week, was postponed to next week following negotiations between Chamber President Hugo Motta and Ministers Bruno Moretti (Planning) and José Guimarães (Institutional Relations), which also include allowing MEIs to hire two employees instead of one. Despite economic team reservations, the government has embraced the measure as an electoral strategy, linking it to the PEC ending the 6×1 work schedule.

item.title: SobeDesce: de Rafael Oliveira a Keir Starmer
item.description: Brazilian executive Rafael Oliveira, 51, has been named the new global CEO of Heineken, the world's second-largest brewery. The Viking chant by Norwegian fans became a viral sensation at the U.S. World Cup, while China's Lineshone supercomputer surpassed U.S. systems to claim the world's fastest title for the first time since 2017. UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer announced his resignation amid electoral setbacks, immigration crisis, and economic stagnation, to be succeeded by fellow Labour member Andy Burnham.

item.title: Ex-ministro de Bolsonaro defende PEC com teto para dívida pública como âncora fiscal para futuro governo
item.description: Former minister Adolfo Sachsida has presented a constitutional amendment proposal (PEC) setting a debt-to-GDP ceiling, which would trigger spending caps if exceeded, as part of the 'Brazil 2026 Project'. He clarifies that the initiative is not tied exclusively to Flávio Bolsonaro but is intended for any opposition candidate, aiming to enable rapid policy implementation at the start of a future government. Sachsida maintains dialogue with Flávio Bolsonaro, a Senate pre-candidate and eldest son of former president Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Michelle estanca queda nas redes depois de atacar Flávio em vídeos
item.description: Videos in which Michelle Bolsonaro criticizes her stepson Flávio Bolsonaro garnered over 32 million views in 24 hours, reversing her ongoing follower loss on Instagram and leading to a resurgence in her social media support.

item.title: Quem é Priscila Costa, pivô da briga entre Flávio e Michelle
item.description: Federal deputy Priscila Costa (PL-CE) is at the center of a dispute between Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro over Senate nominations in Ceará for 2026. Michelle supports Priscila for the Senate, while Flávio backs state deputy Alcides Fernandes, causing internal party conflict. Michelle claims Flávio disrespected her and tried to exclude her from party decisions, despite her leadership in PL Women.

item.title: Fachin envia a Mendonça investigação de Flávio sobre “Dark Horse”
item.description: Supreme Court President Edson Fachin assigned Minister André Mendonça to oversee the criminal complaint investigating Senator Flávio Bolsonaro over alleged funds from Banco Master used to finance the film 'Dark Horse'. The decision was based on the existence of related proceedings already under Mendonça’s rapporteurship, aiming to prevent procedural duplication and ensure preventive case management.

item.title: ‘A história está se repetindo’, diz Bruno Barreto após dirigir obra sobre os ’963 dias’ de Temer
item.description: Filmmaker Bruno Barreto stated he will never direct another documentary after completing '963 dias', a film about Michel Temer's presidency (2016-2018). He likens the film’s sentiment to Stefan Zweig’s feeling on the eve of World War I — a belief in an impending new dawn that actually signaled the end of consensus and the common good in Brazilian public life, paving the way for political radicalism.

item.title: ‘Lua de mel’ de Flávio e remontada de Lula: O que mostraram as pesquisas eleitorais do 1º semestre?
item.description: Electoral polls in the first half of 2026 showed a tight race between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, with the senator gaining ground early due to the petista government's wear and bolsonarist mobilization, before declining after the 'Dark Horse' case. Despite the drop, Flávio showed resilience in voting intentions, while Lula began a recovery tied to improved government approval, though without establishing a clear trend. Experts note that the indices remain close, indicating an undefined election, dependent on the consolidation of the petista pre-campaign.

item.title: Bastidores: Flávio atua para esvaziar peso político da madrasta no PL, mas Michelle não vai recuar
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro is working to diminish the political influence of his stepmother, Michelle Bolsonaro, within the PL, aiming to sideline her in national party maneuvers. He did so by announcing his pre-candidacy without prior consultation, disrupting her potential alliances in São Paulo and Ceará, and attempting to recruit her close allies — such as Damares Alves and Bia Kicis — for his own government plan and vice-presidential ticket. Although Michelle publicly expressed feeling disrespected and faced criticism among right-wing voters, she made clear she will not back down from the conflict.

item.title: Rubio responde carta de Flávio Bolsonaro e reafirma posição dos EUA sobre tarifaço
item.description: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio reaffirmed in a letter to Flávio Bolsonaro that the Donald Trump administration maintains its position in favor of imposing tariffs on Brazil. The letter was a response to an earlier appeal by the PL presidential candidate urging the U.S. not to adopt new trade measures against the country. The exclusive content was obtained by the column and is available only to subscribers.

item.title: Atuação de Flávio nos EUA é lamentável, diz ministro da Fazenda
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan criticized pre-candidate and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's actions in the United States, claiming he violates the Brazilian Constitution by seeking foreign financing for his domestic campaign, harming the country and its companies. Durigan defended the issuance of yuan-denominated bonds as a sovereign decision to diversify funding sources and reduce dollar dependence, despite U.S. tensions, and called U.S. tariffs unjust but said they would not pressure the Ministry's work.

item.title: Podcast discute impactos da briga em público de Michelle e Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: A podcast discusses the impact of a public feud between Michelle and Flávio Bolsonaro on social media, exposing family divisions that undermine the senator’s presidential pre-campaign. The exposure of tensions raises concerns about unity and the political image of the Bolsonaro clan ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Vídeo de Michelle é novo revés para a campanha de Flávio, diz jornal britânico
item.description: A video of former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro involved in a public feud with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro has been highlighted by British media and Bloomberg as a new setback for Flávio’s presidential campaign ahead of an expected October 2026 showdown with Lula. The incident raises concerns about family unity and the public image of the Bolsonaro candidacy.

item.title: Saiba como funciona ajuda humanitária que o Brasil enviará à Venezuela
item.description: Brazil will send humanitarian aid to Venezuela following earthquakes that killed over 180 people and left thousands missing. The mission includes 36 firefighters, civil defense and Anatel technicians, 9 tons of search-and-rescue equipment, medical supplies and solar-powered water purifiers, to be delivered in two FAB flights from Guarulhos to Caracas.

item.title: Crise com Michelle abala campanha de Flávio, e aliados pregam cautela
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro's video denunciation, accusing Flávio Bolsonaro of humiliation and disrespect, deepened a family and political crisis that undermines the senator's pre-campaign for the presidency. Allies say the episode occurred at a delicate moment, interrupting efforts to reposition his image and diverting focus from the positive agenda the campaign had been building. The controversy resurges amid other recent setbacks, including his involvement with banker Daniel Vorcaro to finance the film 'Dark Horse'.

item.title: Desgaste com Michelle Bolsonaro pressiona Flávio a definir vice mulher
item.description: The video released by Michelle Bolsonaro, in which she accuses Flávio Bolsonaro of disrespect and humiliation, has intensified pressure for him to select a woman as his vice-presidential running mate in the 2026 race. The statement resonated strongly with female and evangelical voters — key demographics for his pre-campaign — prompting Flávio to initially downplay the incident and later apologize, aiming to mitigate familial and political fallout. Without Michelle’s support, Flávio is now seeking a female running mate to bolster his appeal among women and ease internal party tensions.

item.title: Governo Lula dá prazo para ONG ligada a 'Dark Horse' prestar contas sob pena de ficar inadimplente
item.description: The Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation has given 15 days for the Instituto Conhecer Brasil (ICB), an NGO led by Karina Gama, to regularize the final accountability of a R$1 million agreement funded by an amendment from federal deputy Mario Frias (PL-SP). The original deadline for accountability expired on April 11, and the full amount has already been disbursed. Failure to comply may result in the entity being declared in default.
